newsitem.title: USA: AT&T says American Telephone settles suit.
newsitem.headline: AT&T says American Telephone settles suit.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Wednesday that long distance reseller American Telephone Network Inc paid an undisclosed sum to the company in a settlement of a dispute going back to 1993.
The settlement follows a dismissal in a pre-trial motion of most of ATN's claims by the United States District Court in Birmingham, Ala.

The claims concerned AT&T's treatment of the reseller which then did not pay the long distance company for services provided. ATN's original suit claimed $40 million from AT&T. ((-- New York Newsrom 212 859 1610))
